description: CyberIntel AI evaluation set. Each answerable question names the document and a short evidence phrase copied from it. A retrieved chunk counts as correct if it comes from that document and contains the phrase. Using a phrase instead of a chunk number means the set keeps working when chunk sizes change.

questions.question: What is CVE-2023-35708?
Which ATT&CK technique is T1490?
Which Log4j versions fix Log4Shell?
questions.evidence: Upgrade to 2.17.1 or later on Java 8

questions.question: How do I detect Log4Shell exploitation?
questions.evidence: Search web, proxy and application logs

questions.question: How can I mitigate Log4Shell if I cannot patch right away?
questions.evidence: remove the JndiLookup class from the classpath

questions.question: Why can a logged User-Agent header lead to code execution in a Java app?
questions.evidence: a logged string cause the application to contact a remote LDAP

questions.question: Who was behind the MOVEit Transfer attacks?
questions.evidence: attributed to the CL0P ransomware and extortion group

questions.question: What web shell was dropped on MOVEit servers?
What should I look for in web server logs to spot MOVEit compromise?
questions.evidence: requests to `human2.aspx`, or any request carrying an `X-siLock-Comment` header

questions.question: A managed file transfer product was hit by SQL injection and used for mass data theft. What happened?
questions.evidence: critical SQL injection vulnerability in the web application of Progress MOVEit Transfer

questions.question: What should we do if we can't patch MOVEit immediately?
questions.evidence: block HTTP and HTTPS traffic to MOVEit Transfer from the internet

questions.question: How do ransomware operators get initial access?
How do ransomware operators stop victims from recovering backups?
What should we do in the first hours of a ransomware incident?
How do attackers steal domain password hashes during an intrusion?
questions.evidence: dumping LSASS memory or the NTDS.dit database

questions.question: What is the KRBTGT reset advice after domain compromise?
questions.evidence: Reset the KRBTGT account password twice

questions.question: Which commands should trigger an alert because they disable recovery?
What is the ticket number of our internal Log4Shell remediation project?
